services.name: Surf Boards
services.desc: We carry a diverse selection of surfboards suitable for any skill level, from beginners to seasoned veterans. Choose between a soft board which will keep you protected during wipeouts, or a stiff fiberglass board that will keep its shape when subjected to the forces of the ocean for higher performance. For beginners, we recommend starting with a longer board, which will help you catch more waves and feel stable riding them. As your skills improve, you can progress to a shorter board which will allow for sharper turns and open the doors to some truly radical maneuvers!
